label: Business burglaries tied to one SUV, New Orleans, 2023

linking_evidence: NOPD says the incidents were found to be connected by the perpetrators' use of a white Nissan Xterra SUV
traffic stop on 2023-07-31 of that SUV found clothing and burglary tools matching those seen in surveillance video of the burglaries
ground_truth.notes: NOPD lists six incidents, four burglaries and two attempts. The arrested vehicle owner faces three counts of simple burglary of a business, one count of attempted simple burglary and one count of simple criminal damage, and the post does not explain the gap. Two other people in the vehicle were detained; their outcome is not reported.

outcome.summary: One arrest on 2023-07-31; NOPD said the investigation was ongoing

data_policy: Public sources only. No suspect or victim names, ages, or exact addresses.
